visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual Esztergom Basilica has a broad pale masonry body, eight free-standing classical portico columns, deep clear portico/inset timber portals, broad entablature and triangular pediment. Two lateral wings have genuine open round arch passages and balustrades; square tower bases carry small oculi, octagonal upper stages with tall dark arched fields, green domes and crosses. The dominant central drum has 24 pale columns and recessed rectangular window bays below a heavy circular cornice and ribbed green copper dome/orb/cross. High side lunettes, lower paired round fields, pilasters, shallow copper roof and rear parapeted terrace distinguish the body. Fixed trim bands crossing tower doors and long stair triangles spilling the conservative footprint into the plaza. Shortened the initially over-tall drum against picture proportions. Fine capitals/reliefs/inscriptions and hidden/current roof details remain approximate.
